title: Multi Cloud Data Engineering | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Multi Cloud Data Engineering. Category: Development. Duration: 9 months. Description: Covers the complete data engineering lifecycle -- data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and deployment across modern cloud platforms. Eligibility: Under Graduate in relevant domain. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
